plan.title: Technical-stage required T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Start an eRFX project.
Enable eRFX projects for the test.
Allow the buyer to add a vendor during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required pricing line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the scenario.
Publish the configured eRFX event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Fill the vendor's technical response using the portal's available quick-fill control.
Accept only the optional clause.
Verify the required clause remains visible for enforcement.
Confirm submission is blocked while the required clause is not accepted.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission check.
Confirm the Technical submission control becomes available.
Submit the vendor's Technical response after accepting both clauses.
Verify the Technical response was submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to verify the Technical-only clauses do not apply there.
Confirm the Technical-stage required clause is not shown on RFQ.
Confirm the Technical-stage optional clause is not shown on RFQ.
